---
title: "Campus Cafe Sales Chart"
---

@fig-cups-bar below summarizes the cups sold by bevarge in a barplot. Coffee sells the most cups, followed by lattes, tea, and hot chocolate.

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Barplot of cups sold by drink"
#| label: fig-cups-bar
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

cafe = pd.read_csv("data/cafe.csv")

plt.bar(cafe["drink"], cafe["cups"])
plt.xlabel("Drink")
plt.ylabel("Cups sold")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
